title: Serialize supervised conversations
hints: Create supervision information while serializing.
Role headers are context even for assistant messages.
Assistant content and its EOS are supervised; BOS and headers are not.

title: Collate variable-length examples
hints: Keep input visibility separate from target supervision.
Right-padding needs both a false attention bit and label -100.
Leave shifting to the loss function.

title: Shift and mask supervised loss
hints: Pair a target with the logit immediately before it.
Apply the mask after shifting the labels.
Divide by the number of supervised targets, not by padded sequence length.

title: Implement low-rank adaptation
hints: Write the matrix shapes before choosing their order.
One factor starts nonzero and the other starts at zero.
The low-rank path must preserve arbitrary leading input dimensions.

title: Inject adapters deliberately
hints: Resolve all requested module names before replacing any.
Qualified paths distinguish identically named nested layers.
Validation failure must leave every target module unchanged.

title: Control the trainable boundary
hints: Identify adapter parameters by object membership.
Freeze the whole model, then select actual adapter A/B objects.
An unrelated parameter named A is not sufficient evidence of an adapter.

title: Run one supervised update
hints: Construct the optimizer from the intended trainable parameters.
Use the same masked loss tested in the prior stage.
The first update may move B without moving A.

title: Merge an adapter for inference
hints: Compare the adapter path with an equivalent dense weight.
Preserve the original layer while constructing the merged result.
Include alpha/rank exactly once.

title: Score whole responses
hints: Score only response targets under their preceding context.
Sum selected log probabilities separately for each example.
An all-masked row sums to zero; do not normalize by response length.

title: Derive the DPO objective
hints: Compute two chosen-versus-rejected margins.
Subtract the reference margin from the policy margin.
The reference contributes values but must not receive gradients.

title: Optimize a preference pair
hints: Keep policy and reference execution roles separate.
Reference evaluation runs without a differentiation graph.
When both models match, the initial loss is log(2).

title: Extract portable adapter weights
hints: Save adapter state without including base weights.
Use qualified module paths and actual adapter types.
Detached CPU clones prevent later training from altering the snapshot.

title: Bind an adapter to its base
hints: An adapter is meaningful relative to a particular base.
Store rank and scale alongside its matrices.
The digest returned describes adapter file bytes; base_sha256 names a different artifact.

title: Restore an adapter atomically
hints: Plan the whole restore before modifying parameters.
Check identity, configuration, keys and every shape first.
A malformed final tensor must not cause partial restoration of earlier tensors.
